name: Ivera Ivermectins 3mg Tablet/s
description:
Ivera 3mg Tablet is an anti-parasitic medicine containing Ivermectin 3mg. It works by binding to glutamate-gated chloride channels in the nerve and muscle cells of parasites, causing paralysis and death of the parasite. It is prescribed for intestinal strongyloidiasis, onchocerciasis (river blindness), scabies, head lice and certain other parasitic worm infections. Manufactured in India in WHO-GMP certified facilities. Sold in strips of 10 tablets.

Key Benefits

  • Broad-spectrum anti-parasitic
  • Single-dose regimens for many indications
  • WHO-GMP certified manufacturing
  • Blister packed for freshness

Ingredients / Composition

Each uncoated tablet contains Ivermectin IP 3mg. Excipients: microcrystalline cellulose, pregelatinised starch, magnesium stearate, butylated hydroxyanisole, citric acid.

How to Use

Take on an empty stomach with a full glass of water, exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Dose is based on body weight and the condition being treated. This is a prescription medicine. Use only under the guidance of a licensed healthcare professional. Do not exceed the prescribed dose. Keep out of reach of children. Store below 25°C, protected from light and moisture.

description:

  • Acts locally in the intestine

Use only under the guidance of a licensed healthcare professional. Do not exceed the prescribed dose. Keep out of reach of children. Store below 25°C, protected from light and moisture.

name: Rifaximine Healing 550 Tabs
description:
Rifaximine Healing 550 contains Rifaximin, a non-absorbable rifamycin antibiotic that acts locally in the gastrointestinal tract. It is prescribed to reduce the recurrence of hepatic encephalopathy, treat irritable bowel syndrome with diarrhoea (IBS-D), and treat traveler's diarrhoea caused by non-invasive E. coli. Because less than 1% is absorbed systemically, side effects are minimal.

Key Benefits

  • Gut-selective – minimal systemic absorption
  • Reduces recurrence of hepatic encephalopathy
  • Relieves IBS-D symptoms
  • Treats traveler's diarrhoea

Ingredients / Composition

Each film-coated tablet contains Rifaximin 550 mg.

How to Use

Typically 550 mg twice or three times daily depending on indication, as prescribed. May be taken with or without food. This is a prescription medicine. Use only under the guidance of a licensed healthcare professional. Do not exceed the prescribed dose. Keep out of reach of children. Store below 25°C, protected from light and moisture.
